benchmarks.name: R-TOFU (Reasoning-TOFU)
benchmarks.scale: 4,000 QA + Aligned CoTs (200 fictitious authors; forget01 / forget05 / forget10)
benchmarks.focus: Entity privacy unlearning across intermediate CoT steps and final answers, plus ZeroThink/LessThink decoding robustness.

benchmarks.name: RMLLMU-Bench
benchmarks.scale: Multi-split Forget / Retain / Celebrity & General VQA with Visual CoTs
benchmarks.focus: Jointly evaluates visual-textual reasoning leakage (`RIL`), answer forgetting, and general multimodal reasoning retention.

benchmarks.name: Leak-Resistant Unlearning Benchmark
benchmarks.scale: 6 logic-guided multi-hop reasoning structures across 2 curated datasets
benchmarks.focus: Measures indirect knowledge leakage via multi-hop logical paths and post-unlearning prompt/parameter recovery attacks.

benchmarks.name: RETURN (Real-World LRM Memorization Split)
benchmarks.scale: 260 deeply memorized public-figure QA pairs (50% Forget / 50% Retain)
benchmarks.focus: Evaluates unlearning of naturally memorized real-world PII in native DeepSeek-R1-Distill CoT trajectories rather than synthetic traces.

benchmarks.name: STAR-1 Harmful-Intent LRM Split
benchmarks.scale: Curated harmful-intent prompts with safety-aligned vs. unsafe reasoning traces
benchmarks.focus: Tests whether LRM unlearning replaces unsafe intermediate rationales with coherent safe-exit trajectories without degenerating.

benchmarks.name: WMDP + StrongReject / WildJailbreak / JBB-Behaviors
benchmarks.type: Hazardous Knowledge & Safety Suites (Adapted to LRMs)
benchmarks.focus: Adopted in R2MU to measure hazardous reasoning trace unlearning (`RT-UA`) alongside final answer suppression (`FA-UA`).

benchmarks.name: AIME 2024 / MATH-500 / GPQA Diamond / GSM8K + LIMO
benchmarks.scale: Competition math, graduate-level STEM QA, and high-quality CoT supervision triplets
benchmarks.focus: Standard utility suites verifying that LRM unlearning does not induce reasoning collapse or degrade test-time scaling competence.

metrics.name: CFE (CoT Forgetting Efficacy)
metrics.description: Aggregates step-level ROUGE recall, step-level cosine similarity, and LLM-as-Judge entailment between generated CoT steps and ground-truth forget facts (higher = stronger trace forgetting).

metrics.name: RT-UA / CoT-UA (Reasoning Trace Unlearning Accuracy)
metrics.description: Fraction or judge-scored rate at which intermediate `<think>...</think>` trajectories still disclose sensitive or hazardous forget-set knowledge (lower = better forgetting).
metrics.reference: R2MU (Wang et al., 2025); CiPO (Li et al., 2026)

metrics.name: RIL (Reasoning Information Leakage)
metrics.description: Quantifies residual target entity/attribute disclosure specifically inside intermediate multimodal reasoning steps on RMLLMU-Bench.

metrics.name: AFE (Answer Forgetting Efficacy)
metrics.description: Complements ROUGE, token probability, truth ratio, and LLM-as-Judge checks on the post-`</think>` final answer span (higher = stronger answer forgetting).

metrics.name: FA-UA / ForgetACC (Final Answer Unlearning Accuracy)
metrics.description: Task accuracy or factual recall on forget-set queries measured strictly on the final output after reasoning terminates (lower = better forgetting).
metrics.reference: R2MU (Wang et al., 2025); CiPO (Li et al., 2026)

metrics.name: RA (Reasoning Ability)
metrics.description: Pass@1 accuracy across held-out multi-step reasoning benchmarks (`AIME 2024`, `MATH-500`, `GPQA Diamond`, `GSM8K`) post-unlearning (higher = better retention).

metrics.name: Reasoning Collapse Rate / Closing-Delimiter Rate
metrics.description: Proportion of responses that degenerate into infinite token loops, gibberish, or fail to emit the closing `</think>` delimiter before token budget exhaustion (0% = collapse-free).

metrics.name: NFRS (Natural Forgetting Reasoning Score)
metrics.description: Evaluates structural boundary stability, fluency, and absence of hallucinated unsupported substitutes in safe-exit CoT trajectories.

metric_groups.group: Decoding Robustness, Privacy & Faithfulness Audit Metrics

metrics.name: ZeroThink / LessThink Decoding Leakage
metrics.description: Measures forgotten knowledge resurgence when bypassing (`<think></think>`) or truncating the thinking phase at inference time.

metrics.name: MCS & Multi-Granularity MIA
metrics.description: Multi-Decoding Consistency Score (`MCS`) across sampling/thinking modes paired with Membership Inference Attacks at both CoT-chain and answer levels.

metrics.name: Decode-Time Prefill Swap & Teacher-Forced Canary Probe
metrics.description: Pairs fixed non-canary thinking prefills with decoding-free teacher-forced continuation scoring to separate true weight memorization from template echo and format drift.

metrics.name: ff-hard & ff-soft (Parametric CoT Faithfulness)
metrics.description: Measures prediction label flip (`ff-hard`) and target-answer probability drop (`ff-soft`) after unlearning a single CoT step from model parameters.

frameworks.name: Unlearn-R2MU
frameworks.description: Official codebase for Reasoning-aware Representation Misdirection for Unlearning (`R2MU`) on DeepSeek-R1-Distill models across WMDP and safety/math suites.

frameworks.name: R-TOFU Benchmark Suite
frameworks.description: Benchmark portal, CoT-annotated fictitious-author splits, step-wise `CFE`/`AFE` evaluators, and `Reasoned IDK` / `ZeroThink` / `LessThink` protocols.

frameworks.name: CiPO
frameworks.description: Counterfactual CoT generator and online iterative SimPO unlearning pipeline evaluated on R-TOFU and real-world RETURN splits.

frameworks.name: REDaCT
frameworks.description: Collapse-free inference-time sentence-level RoBERTa leak detector and corrective embedding optimization for DeepSeek-R1-Distill LRMs.

frameworks.name: GUARD
frameworks.description: Guided Answer-Reasoning Distillation training pipeline and Natural Forgetting Reasoning Score (`NFRS`) evaluation suite.

frameworks.name: PoRT
frameworks.description: Post-judgment and selective multi-round thinking (`SMT`) framework for attack-resilient inference-time unlearning.

frameworks.name: Parametric-Faithfulness (FUR)
frameworks.description: Step-level CoT unlearning pipeline (`FUR`) and `ff-hard`/`ff-soft` parametric faithfulness evaluators.

frameworks.name: UnStar
frameworks.description: Self-taught anti-sample rationale generation and targeted association unlearning implementation.
